name: a short workflow interview
objective: Understand one real recent recurring work task deeply enough to identify where assistance could produce a meaningful improvement, without leading the participant toward a predetermined solution.
greeting: Thanks for joining me. To start, what is your role, and what kind of work fills most of your week?
completion: Briefly reflect back the participant's workflow, hardest moment, consequence, and desired outcome. Ask them to correct anything important. After they confirm or correct the summary, thank them and end the interview.

fields.label: Your context
fields.description: The participant's role, responsibilities, and relevant working context.

fields.label: Recent example
fields.description: One concrete recent example of a recurring task, including what triggered it and what happened.

fields.label: Hardest part
fields.description: The hardest moment in that example and an observable consequence in time, quality, cost, stress, or risk.

fields.label: Better outcome
fields.description: What a materially better outcome would look like, stated without prescribing a particular feature.

fields.label: Follow-up permission
fields.description: Whether the participant would be open to a follow-up conversation.
